intent: Wrap a form control with label, optional hint, and optional error message.
useWhen: Any labeled Input, Textarea, or Select in a form
When validation errors or helper text must appear below the control
doNotUseWhen: Checkbox with inline label — use Checkbox directly unless hint/error is needed
RadioGroup — it provides its own legend
Display-only content — use Section or plain text

requirements: Label htmlFor matches child control id
Error text linked via aria-describedby when present

doNot: Do not wrap Button or layout components
Do not use Field without a kit Input, Textarea, or Select child
snippet: <Field label="Project name" htmlFor="name" hint="Visible to your team"><Input id="name" /></Field>
